# Port of lib/pubid/ieee/parser.rb — the largest flavor: P-prefixed
# drafts (draft status/version/date families, =D ISO stages, /FDIS
# family), approved drafts, ANSI P forms, historical S-designations,
# corrigendum/interpretation/conformance-lead forms, multi-numbered and
# CSA dual-published identifiers, IEEE/ASTM SI/PSI, no-prefix forms,
# joint ISO/IEC/IEEE development formats, IEC/IEEE copublished labels,
# the relationship/parenthetical machinery, book nicknames, redlines,
# and title portions. The Aiee/Ire/Nesc sub-parsers are `use`d. The
# huge parse() normalization pipeline (rev/relaton/joint-stage
# spellings, entity decoding, paren balancing) is Tier-3 preprocessing
# outside the grammar. Source deviations: empty-marker captures
# (:iso_published, :part_dash, :printed_dash_year, :printed_month_year,
# :iec_label_dash) become bracketed optionals (which optional branch
# matched is derivable, so no information is lost); the duplicated
# combined_aiee_identifier branch is emitted once; "Sept"/"Sep"
# (and dotted-month) orders are lint-forced longest-first.

use aiee
use ire
use nesc

grammar PubidIeee version "0.1.0" {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  letter = upper / lower
  digits = 1*digit
  space = " "
  dash = "-" / "–" / "–"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"
  stage_sep = slash / "_"
  comma = ", "
  non_nl = %x01-09 / %x0B-10FFFF
  non_rparen = %x01-27 / %x2A-10FFFF
  non_rbracket = %x01-5C / %x5E-10FFFF
  non_comma_rparen = %x01-28 / %x2A-2B / %x2D-10FFFF
  non_digit_nl = %x01-09 / %x0B-2F / %x3A-10FFFF
  alnum_char = digit / upper / lower

  year_digits = (("19" / "20") 2digit 0*2lower !digits)
  month_numeric = (("0" %x31-39)) / (("1" %x30-32))
  month_name = "Sept." / "Oct." / "Nov." / "Dec." / "Jan." / "Feb." / "Mar." / "Apr." / "Jun." / "Jul." / "Aug." / "September" / "November" / "December" / "February" / "August" / "June" / "January" / "March" / "April" / "October" / "July" / "May" / "Sept" / "Jan" / "Feb" / "Mar" / "Apr" / "Jun" / "Jul" / "Aug" / "Sep" / "Oct" / "Nov" / "Dec"

  date_with_month_text = ((month_name) as month [space] ((year_digits)) as year)
  date_with_month_numeric = (((year_digits)) as year dash (month_numeric) as month)
  date_year_only = (((year_digits)) as year)
  date_standalone = (date_with_month_text / date_with_month_numeric / date_year_only)
  organization = "IEEE" / "AIEE" / "ANSI" / "ASA" / "ANS" / "IEC" / "ISO" / "ASTM" / "CSA" / "ASME" / "NACE" / "NSF" / "ASHRAE" / "NCTA" / "AESC" / "EIA" / "USEMCSC" / "AMPP" / "USAS" / "EAB" / "MPAI"
  complex_org_prefix = "ANSI/IEEE-ANS" / "ANSI/IEEE" / "ANSI"
  characteristic_ieee_number = (("C" 2digit dot digits *lower)) / (("802" dot digits *lower)) / (("P" 1*digits))
  publisher = ((complex_org_prefix)) as publisher / ((organization)) as publisher
  copublisher = (("/ISO/IEC")) as copublisher / (("/IEC/ISO")) as copublisher / ((slash [space] ((organization)) as copublisher))
  conformance = (((([space] slash "Conformance" ((1*digit)) as conf_number ([space] dash [space]) ((year_digits)) as conf_year)))) as conformance
  ashrae_copub = ((((slash "ASHRAE" space [("Guideline" space)] ((digits)) as ashrae_number [(([space] dash [space]) ((year_digits)) as ashrae_year)]))) as ashrae_copub)
  ieee_crossref = ((((slash "C" digits dot digits dot digits ([space] dash [space]) ((year_digits))))) as ieee_crossref)
  ipcea_copub = ((((slash "IPCEA" space (1*(letter / digit / "." / dash))))) as ipcea_copub)
  s_designation = ([(publisher space)] [(((type_word)) as type [space])] (("S" dash digits)) as s_number [ipcea_copub] [parenthetical])
  # A dash group after the number is a PART, not more number (C1: the
  # part binds before the draft status and the year - the dash-continuation
  # swallowed "61850-9-3" whole, and the builder-side Code split came too
  # late for the separator and the P prefix).
  number = ((([("P")] *upper digits *((digits / upper)) [lower])) as number)
  type_word = "Draft Std" / "STD" / "Standard" / "Std No." / "Std" / "PTC" / (("N" / "n") "o.") / (("N" / "n") "o") / "No"
  part = ((dot / dash) !(year_digits) (1*(!(("REV" / "Rev" / "rev")) alnum_char))) as part
  subpart = ((dot / dash / "_") !(year_digits) (1*(!(("REV" / "Rev" / "rev")) (digit / lower)) [(dot digits)])) as subpart
  year = (((([space] (dot / dash) [space])) date_standalone ["(E)"]))
  draft_status = ((("Active Unapproved" / "Active Approved" / "Unapproved" / "Approved" / "Active") space))
  draft_prefix = (([space] ("/" / "_" / dash / space)))
  rev_word = ("REV" / "Rev" / "rev")
  rev_sep = (dash / "_" / dot / space / slash)
  # The lettered revision id ("REVi", "REVmc") is identity - the IEEE 802
  # series letter suffix - and its separator is preserved as printed
  # ("P802.11-REVmc" renders "P802.11-Revmc"; a glued "REVi" stays glued).
  # A draft-D token after the word is the DRAFT (the "REVD2.2" family), so
  # the lettered capture declines it. The word with no id is kept as the
  # rev_bare marker ("802.1AR-Rev/D2.2").
  rev_numbered = ([rev_sep] (rev_word) [space] (1*digit) as revision)
  rev_lettered = (([rev_sep] as rev_sep) (rev_word) (!(("D" digit)) (1*alnum_char)) as revision)
  rev_bare = (([rev_sep] as rev_sep) (rev_word) as rev_bare)
  rev_inline = ((rev_numbered) / (rev_lettered) / (rev_bare))
  draft_version = (!(("R" dash)) [("D" !("IS"))] ((((1*2digit dot 1*2digit dot 1*2digit))) / ((((1*2digit dot 1*2digit [lower]))) / ((dot (!(year_digits)) (1*(alnum_char / dot)))) / (((digits "+" digits))) / (((digits [dot] "e" digits))) / ((((dash) (!(year_digits)) (1*alnum_char) [(("-d") / (("_") *alnum_char))])) / (((dash) (year_digits) as dash_year [dash (month_numeric) as dash_month]))) / (((1*alnum_char) [(("-d") / (("_") *alnum_char))]))) as draft_version))
  # A draft date may comma-join its month and year (", Feb, 2011")
  # - the canonical forced-comma render (IEEE publisher, dated draft).

  draft_date = (((("," [space]) / space) (month_name) as month [(space / comma)] ((year_digits)) as year)) / ((space ((year_digits)) as year)) / ((comma ((year_digits)) as year)) / ((("," / space) (month_numeric) as month (space / dash) ((year_digits)) as year)) / (((([space] comma [space]) / space) (month_name) as month (((space ((digits)) as day) (((("," / space / dash)) ((year_digits)) as year))) / ([((space ((digits)) as day)) comma] ((year_digits)) as year) / ((comma [space] ((year_digits)) as year)) / ((space ((year_digits)) as year))))) / (((([space] comma [space]) / space) (month_name) as month [space] ((("0" %x30-39)) / (("1" %x30-32))) as year)) / ((([space] dash [space]) (year_digits) as dash_year [dash (month_numeric) as dash_month]))
  fdraft = ((((stage_sep ((("FDIS" / "CDV" / "CD" / "WD" / "PWI" / "NP")) as fdraft_stage [(((((("," [space]) / space) (month_name) as month [space] (year_digits) as year))) / (((("," / space) (year_digits) as year))))] [parenthetical]))) as fdraft))
  draft = ((draft_prefix (1*2draft_version) [((dot digits) as revision)] [((("=" (((("D" ("FDIS" / "CDV" / "PWI" / "DIS" / "WD" / "NP" / "CD"))) / (("FDIS" / "CDV" / "PWI" / "DIS" / "WD" / "NP" / "CD"))) as draft_iso_stage)) [(":" / dash) (year_digits) as draft_stage_year] [[(dot / dash)] (digits 0*1letter) as draft_iso_iteration]))] [draft_date])) as draft
  revision_suffix = ((slash "R" dash (1*alnum_char) as revision [([space] dash [space]) (year_digits) as dash_year [dash (month_numeric) as dash_month]])) / ((slash "D" dash) (slash "R" dash) (1*alnum_char) as revision [([space] dash [space]) (year_digits) as dash_year [dash (month_numeric) as dash_month]]) / (rev_numbered) / (rev_lettered)
  edition = ((((comma (year_digits) as edition_year " Edition"))) / ((((space / dash)) "Edition " ((digits dot digits)) as edition (((" - ")) / space / dash) ((year_digits)) as edition_year [(dash (2digit) as edition_month)])))
  part_subpart_year = ((part (1*2subpart) year)) / ((part subpart year)) / ((part year)) / ((part subpart)) / (year) / (part)
  # The corrigendum ordinal may carry a placeholder year ("Cor 1-201x")
  # and may be followed by the corrigendum's own draft (", D4, July
  # 2015"): a comma-form year wins before the trailing-comma eater that
  # hands the tail to the draft slot.
  # The corrigendum ordinal may carry a placeholder year ("Cor 1-201x"),
  # a comma year ("Cor 1, 2015"), or hand its trailing comma to the
  # corrigendum's own draft (", D4, July 2015") — three alternatives,
  # no mid-alternative backtracking.
